summary: The CPU diagnostic implements the planned annotation-derived pre-jitter capture and fixed-candidate counterfactual correctly. No blocking source defect was found. Actual augmented64 replay and clean-label results remain unexecuted.

provenance.execution: Read source, parse Python AST, inspect closed local JSON/NPZ, and execute isolated pure methods locally. No experiment entrypoint, SSH, deployment, dataset replay, model/GPU operation, checkpoint load, or package installation was performed by this reviewer.

verified_design.detail: The override selects the native root target and calls Scan.get_object_bbox on the already augmented native scan before delegating unchanged to the native target-box method. The bbox method reads annotated object memberships and computes low/high corners with no RNG or mutation. Casting those corners to float64 before center/size arithmetic matches assignment into native float64 bboxes; the final float32 cast matches native returned center_label/size_gts.

verified_design.topic: RNG, workers, and native data preservation
verified_design.detail: The capture introduces no random call and invokes the original target-box function once. The existing gt_masks boolean conversion is identical to the prior probe. The fit subset, seed2027, shuffle, batch8, num_workers2, generator, pin_memory and drop_last configuration match the prior cohort. Both probes reset CPU RNGs directly before loader iteration; omitted CUDA seeding cannot change the CPU worker generator. Native point augmentation, target jitter and detected-box augmentation remain enabled.

The source requires native dataset import path/SHA, registered partitions and seed/batch parameters; repeats the prior no-augmentation reference hashes/text; additionally checks capture equals unjittered native root labels; and then requires all64 row IDs in order, scan IDs, point bytes, noisy root values and valid slots [0] to match closed evidence. Mismatch raises before the complete receipt is emitted. These are source gates; the real64 replay remains pending.

All64x256 candidates for parent/control/query_supported use stored boxes. Native noisy-label Hungarian assignments and query/fused mask intersections/unions remain fixed. IoU uses center-size AABBs and strict >0.5 success; qualification is supported, unmatched and parent IoU<=0.5. Boundary targets use the same clamped coarse sizes, scale4 and knots endpoints[-4,4] as the exact prior helper. The original1090-candidate noisy cohort remains fixed for paired geometry changes, with separately named clean-qualified groups.

The loader uses only the registered fit subset for the counterfactual. There is no optimizer, model construction/forward or checkpoint access in the new entrypoint. Dataset superpoint tensors are data loads, not model weights. The source keeps CUDA hidden and checks it is uninitialized. The analyzer explicitly limits the output to correlated augmented training candidates, with no DFL recalculation, protocol change, formal accuracy result or causal conclusion.

The launcher reads credentials only from the existing environment, uses system host keys with Paramiko's default rejection of unknown hosts, quotes shell arguments, requires the reviewed unchanged files, and creates the fixed new remote directory. The collector reads the bounded diagnostic directory and performs no model rerun. No concrete credential/network-boundary defect was found.
